latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the US-Iran War Tracker (English):

- Focuses exclusively on real-time tracking of the US-Iran conflict using intelligence from the past 6 hours.
- Implements a mandatory triangulation protocol to verify all claims, mitigating disinformation risks.
- Provides a detailed intelligence reporting workflow, including strict keyword use and authoritative tiered source consultation.
- Sets clear report structuring guidelines: minimum 1,000-word English reports, with attribution and thematic organization.
- Introduces a rolling, time-stamped event log for ongoing situation awareness.
